evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Horizontal oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn-body junction.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade articular cartilage loss at the weightbearing and posterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle with areas of high-grade cartilage loss and full-thickness fissuring.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage loss at the posterior lateral femoral condyle with areas of full-thickness fissuring.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity at the patella and trochlea with large confluent regions of full-thickness cartilage loss at the medial patellar facet and full-thickness fissuring throughout the trochlea.
evidence.Synovitis: Small multiloculated leaking Baker's cyst with synovitis.
